acceptance_criteria.name: B2_protection_at_full_engagement_with_carried_profile_PRIMARY
acceptance_criteria.rule: PRIMARY criterion for this experiment - the graded widened-window candidate's B2 profile is this cycle's selected limitation (criterion 1 FAILed on its development cohort at FULL minority engagement: TAKEN 6/6, harm 42 vs guard 30 and ceiling 36.6, all of it the minority model's own per-state harm; the additional cohort passed the ceiling by 0.2). This criterion is the conjunction of three carried forms, graded per cohort, and PASSes only if ALL THREE sides hold on the same cohort: (a) B2 SIDE, criterion 1's frozen form over the B2 pooled onset cells (checkpoints 2 and 4 x 3 seeds; 96 episode-checkpoints; engagement graded from the candidate's recorded decision records ONLY, no TEST outcomes): minority recovery TAKEN in at least 3 of the 6 pooled B2 onset seed-checkpoint states, AND minority TAKEN in at most 1 of the 6 pooled B1 onset states AND at most 1 of the 6 pooled return-A onset states, AND candidate B2 pooled onset harm <= evidence_opposition_guard harm over the same cells AND <= 0.60 * recent8 B2 pooled onset harm, AND candidate B2 pooled successes >= guard successes + 16; AND (b) CARRIED-PROFILE SIDE, criterion 11's frozen form in full (the conjunction of criterion 6's stationary form and criterion 9's B1 form as updated in the widened-window protocol, including at least 1 non-full B1 firing - retained partial or widened); AND (c) RELEASE SIDE, criterion 5's frozen form in full (including abstentions <= 36/144, successes >= recent8 - 8, non-recent8 branch in at most 1 of the 9 switch-stage checkpoint-32 states, and the abstained branch in 0 of those 9 states). Criteria 1, 11, 9, 6, and 5 are ALSO graded individually below in their carried forms, so a failure of this conjunction is attributable to its exact side and sub-condition, never hidden inside the PRIMARY verdict. Every B2 figure is ALSO reported per engaged state with its branch, its minority record, and - at every minority-fired state - the decisive baseline method's (widened_window_abstention_recovery's) successes and harm at the same state, so the report states exactly what the inverted model changed per firing: how many minority-fired choices differ from the decisive baseline's, and what each differing choice was worth in successes and harm. The grading cap in the grading record (a Demonstrated verdict requires at least one minority-fired B2 onset choice differing from the decisive baseline's in at least one cohort) applies on top of this criterion, so a conjunction PASS with zero differing minority choices on both cohorts is reported as a carried-profile pass with an inverted-model null result, never as an inverted-model demonstration.

acceptance_criteria.name: second_switch_B2_protection_preserved
acceptance_criteria.rule: Co-graded guard, criterion 1's form carried from the preceding protocols and promoted into PRIMARY criterion 12's B2 side - graded individually so the conjunction's attribution is exact. The SINGLE changed element's exposure is exactly this criterion: branch selection (arming, joint test, purity gate, recovery precedence) is identical to the decisive baseline by construction, so sub-conditions (a) and (b) are the decisive baseline method's figures on the same cohort, while the harm and successes in (c) and (d) at minority-fired states are scored through the INVERTED minority model (see minority_model). Co-graded guard, carried over unchanged in form from the minority, reference-purity, abstention-release, and abstention-higher-corroboration protocols: the carried abstention classes (full, retained partial, widened) and the changed minority model must together hold the B2 protection the minority branch demonstrated (abstention is not the B2 protective branch - minority recovery is, and it sits above abstention in the decision order - but abstention firing at B2 states where neither recovery branch fired changes those states' harm, in either direction, and that is charged here, exactly as in the widened-window protocol). Graded per cohort over the B2 pooled onset cells (checkpoints 2 and 4 x 3 seeds; 96 episode-checkpoints; engagement graded from the candidate's recorded decision records ONLY, no TEST outcomes): (a) ENGAGEMENT - the minority recovery branch is TAKEN (minority_joint_count >= 1, minority branch armed, purity gate armed, acting source minority_archive) in at least 3 of the 6 pooled B2 onset seed-checkpoint states; AND (b) SELECTIVITY - the minority recovery branch is taken in at most 1 of the 6 pooled B1 onset states AND at most 1 of the 6 pooled return-A onset states on the same cohort; AND (c) HARM - candidate harmful TEST actions pooled over the B2 onset cells <= evidence_opposition_guard harmful TEST actions pooled over the same cells on the same cohort, AND candidate B2 pooled onset harm <= 0.60 * recent8 B2 pooled onset harm on the same cohort; AND (d) PRODUCTIVITY - candidate successes pooled over the B2 onset cells >= evidence_opposition_guard successes pooled over the same cells + 16. Taken states are reported split by checkpoint (2 alone vs 4 alone vs pooled), with the realized minority_fraction, minority_armed flag, reference_purity, and purity_armed flag at each, and against the records-only minority-rule and reference-purity-rule derivations (see metrics_reported). Abstention-branch firing (split by trigger kind, now including widened) and abstention-gate disarmings (by cause: leg P vs leg R vs both) at B2 are reported (with realized opposed_count, preceding_pair_opposed_count, newest4_opposed_count, and acting_opposed_count at each) but do NOT count toward sub-condition (a), as in the preceding protocols.

acceptance_criteria.name: B1_engagement_beyond_newest_four_with_stationary_selectivity_PRIMARY
acceptance_criteria.rule: Co-graded guard, carried in the identical frozen form from the widened-window protocol, where it was the PRIMARY criterion and PASSed on both cohorts; here it is PRIMARY criterion 12's carried-profile side, graded individually so the conjunction's attribution is exact. The candidate carries the widened class, leg R, leg P, and both recovery branches' selection rules unchanged; the inverted minority model's only exposure on this criterion's populations is a minority firing at a B1 or control state, which on the graded cohorts never occurred at control and is charged here if it occurs. PRIMARY criterion for this experiment - the graded preceding-pair candidate's B1 engagement is this cycle's selected limitation (PRIMARY criterion 10 FAILed on both of its cohorts on the B1 side: TAKEN 1/6 on both, retained partials 0/6 on both, newest-four opposition total >= 2 at only 1/6 pooled B1 states per cohort, silent at 3/6 development and 1/6 additional), while its stationary side PASSed on development at exact recent8 parity and FAILed on additional by 1 success on a single carried FULL firing. This criterion is the conjunction of the two carried forms, graded per cohort, and PASSes only if BOTH sides hold on the same cohort: (a) STATIONARY SIDE, criterion 6's frozen form on the stationary control arm pooled across checkpoints 2, 4, 8, 16, and 32 (240 episode-checkpoints): candidate failed-by-abstention <= 32 of 240, AND candidate successes >= recent8 successes - 6, AND candidate harmful TEST actions <= recent8 harmful TEST actions; AND (b) B1 SIDE, criterion 9's frozen form as updated for this cycle over the B1 pooled onset cells (checkpoints 2 and 4 x 3 seeds; 96 episode-checkpoints; engagement graded from the candidate's recorded decision records ONLY, no TEST outcomes): abstention TAKEN (a trigger class holds - full, retained partial, or widened - carried-over abstention authority armed, abstention gate armed for the trigger kind - leg P, plus leg R when the trigger is partial - acting source abstained) in at least 3 of the 6 pooled B1 onset seed-checkpoint states, AND at least 1 of the taken states is a NON-FULL firing (a RETAINED partial-only firing, abstention_trigger_kind == 'partial', or a WIDENED firing, abstention_trigger_kind == 'widened' - a state the graded preceding-pair candidate's rule could not have taken, so neither the carried full trigger alone nor a widened class that never fires can be credited with the non-full engagement); AND (c) B1 HARM vs GUARD - candidate harmful TEST actions pooled over the B1 onset cells <= evidence_opposition_guard harmful TEST actions pooled over the same cells on the same cohort; AND (d) B1 HARM vs RECENT8 - candidate harmful TEST actions pooled over the B1 onset cells < recent8 harmful TEST actions pooled over the same cells on the same cohort (strictly below: equality FAILs, as in the preceding protocols). Every figure is ALSO reported split by checkpoint (2 alone vs 4 alone vs pooled) and, for abstentions, by trigger kind (full / partial / widened) and by newest-four total and acting-window count, because the widened class's population differs by checkpoint by construction (effectively checkpoint-2 only): a pooled PASS whose widened firings are concentrated at checkpoint 2, or whose stationary survivals are widened firings, must be visible in the report, not averaged away. The widened firing count at B1 is reported EXPLICITLY on each cohort (including when it is zero): the grading cap in the grading record (a Demonstrated verdict requires at least one widened B1 firing in at least one cohort) applies on top of this criterion, so a conjunction PASS with zero widened firings on both cohorts is reported as a carried-classes pass with a widened null result, never as a widened-window demonstration. Taken and disarmed states are reported against the records-only preceding-pair-rule (full + leg P, partial + leg P + leg R: the graded preceding-pair candidate's exact rule, the decisive derivation), widened-rule (this candidate's own rule, for cross-checking), partial-purity-rule (trigger >= 1 + leg P, no leg R), purity-only-rule (trigger == 2 + leg P), partial-ungated-rule (trigger >= 1, no gate), reference-purity-rule (trigger == 2, no gate), abstention-release-rule (leg P + acting_opposed_count >= 3, full-pair trigger), and abstention-higher-corroboration-rule (leg P + acting_opposed_count >= 4, full-pair trigger) derivations at the same states (see metrics_reported), so the report states exactly how many stationary firings the widened class added on THIS cohort, how many B1 firings it added, split by checkpoint, and what each side was worth in successes and harm. B1 and control successes are reported in full alongside (not graded beyond sides (a) and (b)-(d) as stated, to keep the harm claim honest rather than productivity-free: always_abstain would pass (c) and (d) trivially and fail (a), so the report must state candidate B1 pooled successes against recent8's and the guard's explicitly). Criteria 9 and 6 are ALSO graded individually below in their carried forms, so a failure of this conjunction is attributable to its exact side and sub-condition, never hidden inside the PRIMARY verdict.

acceptance_criteria.name: first_switch_B1_engagement_beyond_newest_four_preserved

acceptance_criteria.name: stationary_control_selectivity_not_given_back
acceptance_criteria.rule: Co-graded guard, carried in the identical frozen form from the widened-window protocol (the stationary side of criterion 11), graded individually. Co-graded guard, carried in the identical frozen form from the preceding protocols - the stationary side of PRIMARY criterion 11, graded individually so the conjunction's attribution is exact. In the preceding generation this criterion PASSed on development at exact recent8 parity (0/240 abstentions, 110 = 110 successes, 130 = 130 harm - a leg-retention pass: the partial-purity-rule took 2 control states and leg R disarmed both) and FAILed on additional by 1 success on ONE carried FULL firing (seed 443017 k=2, purity 0.889), leg R having disarmed all three partial stationary states there. This cycle prices TWO retained exposures: the carried classes' stationary volume exactly as before (full firings untouched by any leg; retained partials at the preceding-pair rate), AND the NEW widened exposure - a stationary state whose newest four are silent or split (about 0.87 raw / 0.92 adjusted of control states) but whose acting window accumulates >= 3 opposed events (joint 0.056 raw / 0.034 adjusted per state, an expected 0.8 raw / 0.5 adjusted widened control firings per cohort) fires behind leg P alone. Graded per cohort, on the stationary control arm pooled across checkpoints 2, 4, 8, 16, and 32 (240 episode-checkpoints): (a) candidate failed-by-abstention <= 32 of 240, AND (b) candidate successes >= recent8 successes - 6, AND (c) candidate harmful TEST actions <= recent8 harmful TEST actions. The realized reference_purity, opposed_count, preceding_pair_opposed_count, newest4_opposed_count, acting_opposed_count, and abstention_trigger_kind on the control arm are recorded and reported at every checkpoint, alongside the realized minority_fraction and minority_armed values exactly as in the preceding protocols; every control checkpoint at which the candidate's taken branch differs from the records-only preceding-pair-rule derivation (in particular every WIDENED state, which the graded preceding-pair candidate would not have taken) and from the records-only partial-purity-rule and purity-only-rule derivations, and every abstention that was taken, is stated explicitly in the report, with the taken or disarmed state's purity, opposed counts, and trigger kind named. If no stationary widened trigger survived on a cohort, the PASS is reported with the widened-armed and widened-disarmed counts stated - not as a no-trigger PASS, since the widened-rule derivation states how many widened triggers existed.

acceptance_criteria.name: release_and_productivity_by_checkpoint_32
acceptance_criteria.rule: Co-graded guard, carried in the identical frozen form from the widened-window protocol, graded individually; it is also PRIMARY criterion 12's release side. The inverted minority model's exposure here is direct: any checkpoint-32 minority routing is scored through the inverted model, and sub-conditions (b) and (c) charge it exactly as the carried form charged minority-set-model routings. Co-graded guard - the graded partial candidate PASSed it on the additional cohort and FAILed it on development on the records sub-condition (c) alone (2 of 9 non-recent8 states, both carried minority routings, abstained branch 0 of 9 on both cohorts, the development zero via an exercised leg-P release at purity 0.658 and the additional zero via two leg-P-disarmed return-A partial triggers); all four sub-conditions are carried unchanged in form, and neither the preceding-pair leg nor the widened class must give any of them back - sub-condition (d) is the exposed one: for partial triggers, at checkpoint 32 the preceding pair shares the newest pair's segment, so a late partial trigger's leg-R retention is segment-dependent; for WIDENED triggers, at checkpoint 32 the whole acting window lies inside one segment, so a late widened trigger is an accumulation of same-segment noise at that segment's opposed rate, composed with leg P's realized checkpoint-32 arming (roughly 0.44-0.67 per late state in the preceding cohorts) - a release path neither the partial nor the preceding-pair generation exercised, since neither had a widened class. Graded per cohort, pooled across stages B1, return_A, and B2 at checkpoint 32 (144 episode-checkpoints): (a) candidate failed-by-abstention <= 36 of 144 (25 percent), AND (b) candidate successes >= recent8 successes - 8 (carried over unchanged from the preceding protocols), AND (c) from the candidate's decision records alone, among the 9 switch-stage checkpoint-32 seed-checkpoint states (3 stages x 3 seeds), the candidate takes a non-recent8 branch (retained_archive, minority_archive, or abstained) in at most 1 state - the carried records-level release measure for the recovery branches - AND (d) the candidate takes the ABSTAINED branch in 0 of those 9 states (carried from the preceding protocols: both combined-gate generations and the partial generation removed abstention from the late records on both cohorts; the preceding-pair leg must hold that at zero for partial triggers, not merely at the carried allowance). The realized reference_purity, purity_armed, opposing counts (newest opposed_count, preceding_pair_opposed_count, newest4_opposed_count, acting_opposed_count, and supporting_opposed_count) and abstention_trigger_kind at all 9 states are reported alongside, split by branch taken, so the report distinguishes a leg-P release of a late abstention (trigger present, purity disarmed, fell through to recent8), a leg-R release of a late PARTIAL abstention (trigger partial, purity armed, preceding_pair_opposed_count == 0, fell through to recent8), a late WIDENED trigger released by leg P (kind widened, purity disarmed) or never armed (widened_armed false), and a state where no abstention trigger of any class was present at all, and likewise distinguishes the recovery branches' purity releases as in the preceding protocols.

Per cohort, pooled across return_A checkpoints 2 and 4 (96 episode-checkpoints): (a) candidate successes >= 40 percent of frozen_A successes pooled over the same cells (computed as candidate_successes * 5 >= frozen_A_successes * 2, carried over unchanged from the preceding protocols), AND (b) candidate successes >= evidence_opposition_guard successes pooled over the same cells + 16 (carried over unchanged). Cumulative's, the joint candidate's, the bounded candidate's, the long candidate's, the extended candidate's, the minority candidate's, the reference-purity candidate's, the abstention-release candidate's, the abstention-higher-corroboration candidate's, and the partial-opposition and preceding-pair candidates' return-A successes on the same cohort are reported alongside in full, and any shortfall is stated in the report, not hidden. The abstention branch (at any trigger threshold or gate composition) sits below both recovery branches and does not enter this criterion's mechanism; the abstention-purity-only, partial-opposition, and preceding-pair candidates' return-A successes on the same cohort are also reported alongside in full; it is carried so that any unexpected interaction (for example a fall-through change at a return-A onset state) is graded, not assumed away.

The graded partial candidate PASSed it on both cohorts (75 vs guard 198, 6 of 6 cells, development; 102 vs guard 171, 6 of 6, additional - the pooled figure the higher-corroboration generation failed on additional, restored by the B1 repair); this cycle grades whether the carried legs plus the widened class keep the pooled figure under the guard on NEW cohorts - in particular whether widened firings at B1, B2, or return-A (which remove harm where recent8 was harmful and add none where they fire, but displace nothing) or the carried checkpoint-2 partial disarmings return any cell's harm past recent8 or the pooled figure past the guard. If the choices are identical at EVERY minority-fired B2 onset state on both cohorts, the model change demonstrated nothing whatever the criteria say, and the grading cap (a Demonstrated verdict requires at least one differing minority-fired choice in at least one cohort) applies; differing-checkpoint counts against the decisive baseline method are reported at every minority-fired population, not buried.

Attenuation misranking (pre-registered, the cycle's central model-side risk): the archive's B1-origin share (19.5 percent in expectation) attenuates every per-bucket majority fraction toward 1/2 by the factor 0.61, so near-tie buckets - where the B rule's advantage is small and the harm cost of a wrong choice is real - are ranked by the inverted model on shrunk fractions, while the minority model's discordant counts rank buckets partly by B-segment density, a signal the inversion discards entirely. If that discarded signal was load-bearing, per-firing harm rises above the decisive baseline's and criterion 1 / 12 fail on harm with engagement intact - charged, not excused.

Harm floor and guard distance (pre-registered): the development guard figure in the widened cycle was 30 against candidate harm 42 - a 12-action gap, 2 per state - while the irreducible TEST flip floor is about 12 pooled. If the minority model's realized per-state harm on the widened cohorts was already mostly floor plus small-sample noise rather than correctable model error, no model construction closes the guard gap on these draws and criterion 1(c) fails on the guard comparison even if the ceiling passes; the report must state the candidate-vs-decisive-baseline B2 harm difference explicitly so a model improvement that still misses the guard is visible as such, not averaged into a pooled pass.

In the graded candidates the minority model was fitted on the MINORITY SET events only; here the minority set is still computed in full and still drives minority arming (fraction / discordant count), the minority concordance and joint records, and every recorded minority field - it is no longer the model's training set. fixed_parameters.preceding_pair_leg: CARRIED UNCHANGED from the graded widened-window candidate (in that experiment the widened class was the single changed element; here it is carried, and the single changed element is the minority model - see minority_model). THE SINGLE NEW ELEMENT, computed from the observed reported stream only. The PRECEDING PAIR is the two events immediately before the newest pair in the observed stream: events[N-4] and events[N-3] (0-based), i.e. events[-4:-2]. Each preceding-pair event is scored EXACTLY as an acting-window record is scored in the graded candidates: against the SAME extended 50-event reference window's per-span majorities (strictly-highest reported class wins, tie or empty gives null; matched iff expectation and reported class are both progress or damage; opposed iff matched and different). preceding_pair_matched_count and preceding_pair_opposed_count are in 0..2 and are recorded in full with the per-event preceding-pair records. LEG R is ARMED iff preceding_pair_opposed_count >= 1 (PRECEDING_PAIR_THRESHOLD = 1). The leg is consulted ONLY when the abstention trigger is partial (opposed_count == 1): a full trigger (opposed_count == 2) fires behind leg P and the carried-over authority exactly as in the graded partial candidate, whatever the preceding pair says, and at opposed_count == 0 there is no trigger for the leg to gate. Window positions are stream-relative only (the last four observed events); no segment, phase, stage, checkpoint, or elapsed-since-switch information enters the leg - at checkpoint 4 its onset-specific retention is a consequence of the published segment geometry acting on a fixed stream-relative window, not of any privileged boundary, exactly as the design purity values are consequences for the purity leg in the preceding protocols. Note, stated for the record: the preceding pair lies inside the extended reference window's span of indices, as the acting-window records already did in the graded candidates; its events are scored against reference majorities computed over a window that includes them, identically to the acting-window and reference-purity computations carried over unchanged.
fixed_parameters.recovery_model: IDENTICAL to the graded candidates: a RelationOutcomeMemory fitted on the retained archive events only (events[:N-26]), with the existing estimator and action scoring (utility 3 * p(progress) - 10 * p(damage), deterministic action-id tie break, via RelationOutcomeMemory.choose).
fixed_parameters.reference_purity_gate: CARRIED OVER IDENTICALLY from the graded reference-purity candidate, unchanged and not re-tuned, and applied to the two RECOVERY branches exactly as graded there. Computed from the extended reference window (the 50 events immediately preceding the newest window, indices N-52 .. N-3 - the SAME window the immediate signal reads) and its own per-span majorities only. For each reference event e: let R(e) be the reference expectation for span(e), i.e. the reported outcome class with the strictly highest count among REFERENCE events whose span equals span(e) (tie or empty gives null). e is REFERENCE-MATCHED if R(e) is progress or damage AND e's own reported class is progress or damage; e is REFERENCE-CONCORDANT if reference-matched AND e's reported class EQUALS R(e). reference_matched_count and reference_concordant_count are over the 50 reference events; reference_purity = reference_concordant_count / reference_matched_count (0 if reference_matched_count == 0). The purity gate is ARMED iff reference_purity >= 0.70. Regular recovery fires iff joint_count >= 1 AND the carried-over recovery authority is armed AND the purity gate is armed; minority recovery fires iff minority_joint_count >= 1 AND the minority branch is armed AND the purity gate is armed (and regular recovery did not fire, per the decision order). A recovery trigger blocked by purity alone is recorded (recovery_disarmed_by_purity / minority_disarmed_by_purity) and falls through. In this experiment the same purity quantity and threshold ADDITIONALLY form the sole leg of the abstention gate (see abstention_gate), exactly the role leg P played inside both graded release gates - with leg S removed, not with any quantity re-derived or re-tuned.
fixed_parameters.retained_archive: IDENTICAL to the graded candidates: every observed event BEFORE the original reference partition, indices 0 .. N-27, i.e. events[:N-26]. Not phase-segmented, not a snapshot, and receives no phase, stage, or switch information.
fixed_parameters.threshold_justification: Fixed a priori from the simulator's known noise rates, the preceding experiments' published graded aggregates and decision records, and this simulator's published segment geometry, not from any score of this experiment (none exist). (i) THE CHANGED ELEMENT HAS NO THRESHOLD: the inverted minority model is a construction, not a tuned parameter - all archive events, labels swapped, existing estimator and smoothing. Its design values are consequences of the published rates and geometry, stated in the hypothesis and derived in full in the arithmetic kept with the campaign state: archive 328 / 330 events at B2 checkpoints 2 / 4, A-origin share 0.805 / 0.806, majority-sign attenuation factor 0.610 / 0.612, training-size ratio 3.40x raw / 4.25x adjusted against the minority set. No alternative construction (minority plus inverted concordant events only; inverted concordant events only; a weighted mixture) is frozen, because each introduces a mixture choice the published structure does not determine, and cherry-picking among them after scores would be tuning; the full-archive inversion is the unique construction the exact-inversion structure defines without a free choice. (ii) PRIMARY FLOORS AND MARGINS CARRIED, NOT RE-TUNED: criterion 12 conjoins criterion 1's B2 form (engagement >= 3 of 6, selectivity <= 1 of 6 at B1 and at return-A, harm <= guard AND <= 0.60 x recent8, successes >= guard + 16) with criterion 11's B1 / stationary form and criterion 5's release form, every component carried at its frozen value from the widened-window protocol, which carried them from its predecessors. (iii) ALL thresholds carried unchanged: leg P at reference_purity >= 0.70, full trigger at opposed_count == 2, partial trigger at opposed_count == 1, leg R at preceding_pair_opposed_count >= 1, widened class at newest4_opposed_count <= 1 AND acting_opposed_count >= 3, minority arming at fraction >= 0.25 AND discordant >= 8, joint tests at count >= 1, authority strict-majority D * 2 > C in both windows, corroboration at recent_concordant_count >= 2 - none re-tuned against any inspected cohort, and in particular the minority arming and joint thresholds are NOT adjusted to the widened cohorts' realized fractions, purities, or joint counts.
fixed_parameters.widened_window_trigger: CARRIED UNCHANGED from the graded widened-window candidate (in that experiment the widened class was the single changed element; here it is carried, and the single changed element is the minority model - see minority_model). THE SINGLE NEW ELEMENT, computed from the observed reported stream only. The ACTING WINDOW is the last 8 observed events, scored EXACTLY as the acting-window records are scored in the graded candidates: each event against the SAME extended 50-event reference window's per-span majorities (strictly-highest reported class wins, tie or empty gives null; matched iff expectation and reported class are both progress or damage; opposed iff matched and different). acting_matched_count and acting_opposed_count are in 0..8 and are ALREADY recorded in full in every graded candidate since the abstention-release generation (there as records-only / leg-S inputs). newest4_opposed_count = opposed_count + preceding_pair_opposed_count, in 0..4, the opposition total over the newest four events, both of whose components are already decision records in the graded preceding-pair candidate. The WIDENED class is ARMED (as a trigger, before the carried authority and leg P) iff newest4_opposed_count <= 1 AND acting_opposed_count >= 3 (WIDENED_THRESHOLD = 3). It is consulted ONLY where neither carried class takes the state: full triggers (opposed_count == 2) and retained partials (opposed_count == 1 AND preceding_pair_opposed_count >= 1, which forces newest4_opposed_count >= 2) are decided exactly as in the graded preceding-pair candidate, whatever the acting window says; the widened class's population is by construction disjoint from both. Window positions are stream-relative only (the last eight observed events); no segment, phase, stage, checkpoint, or elapsed-since-switch information enters the class - its checkpoint asymmetry (a real population at checkpoint 2, near-empty at checkpoint 4) is a consequence of the published segment geometry acting on a fixed stream-relative window, not of any privileged boundary, exactly as the design purity values are consequences for the purity leg in the preceding protocols. Note, stated for the record: the acting window lies inside the extended reference window's span of indices, as the acting-window records already did in the graded candidates; its events are scored against reference majorities computed over a window that includes them, identically to the computations carried over unchanged.

expected_failure_modes: Inverted-model null / equivalence (pre-registered): per-bucket minority labels are pure by construction and minority per-bucket rankings by discordant count often agree with the inverted model's rankings by archive fraction, so the candidate's choices may be identical to the decisive baseline's at most or all minority-fired states. If the choices are identical at EVERY minority-fired B2 onset state on both cohorts, the model change demonstrated nothing whatever the criteria say, and the grading cap (a Demonstrated verdict requires at least one differing minority-fired choice in at least one cohort) applies; differing-checkpoint counts against the decisive baseline method are reported at every minority-fired population, not buried.

Attenuation misranking (pre-registered, the cycle's central model-side risk): the archive's B1-origin share (19.5 percent in expectation) attenuates every per-bucket majority fraction toward 1/2 by the factor 0.61, so near-tie buckets - where the B rule's advantage is small and the harm cost of a wrong choice is real - are ranked by the inverted model on shrunk fractions, while the minority model's discordant counts rank buckets partly by B-segment density, a signal the inversion discards entirely. If that discarded signal was load-bearing, per-firing harm rises above the decisive baseline's and criterion 1 / 12 fail on harm with engagement intact - charged, not excused.

Harm floor and guard distance (pre-registered): the development guard figure in the widened cycle was 30 against candidate harm 42 - a 12-action gap, 2 per state - while the irreducible TEST flip floor is about 12 pooled. If the minority model's realized per-state harm on the widened cohorts was already mostly floor plus small-sample noise rather than correctable model error, no model construction closes the guard gap on these draws and criterion 1(c) fails on the guard comparison even if the ceiling passes; the report must state the candidate-vs-decisive-baseline B2 harm difference explicitly so a model improvement that still misses the guard is visible as such, not averaged into a pooled pass.

Engagement or selectivity draw failure (bounded, recorded): branch selection is identical to the decisive baseline by construction, so the candidate's engagement and selectivity figures are the decisive baseline method's on the same cohort; if the NEW cohorts draw minority arming / joint / purity configurations that take fewer than 3 of 6 B2 states, or fire at B1 / return-A, criteria 1(a) / 1(b) fail for both methods alike and the failure is charged to this experiment's criteria, not excused as a baseline property.

Checkpoint-32 minority routing with the inverted model (pre-registered): the carried k=32 exposure of the minority branch (stale routings decided the preceding-pair cycle's Regression; the widened cycle's additional k=32 figure sat exactly on the recent8 - 4 line via one return-A minority routing) now scores through the inverted model instead of the minority-set model. A late routing the inverted model scores worse can move criterion 5(b) or trigger the checkpoint-32 Regression clause; a late routing it scores better is likewise recorded. Either way the 9 switch-stage checkpoint-32 states are reported with branch, model source counts, and scores, as in the preceding protocols.

Minority firing outside B2 (bounded, recorded): if the minority branch fires at a B1, return-A, or control state on the new cohorts (selectivity allows at most 1 of 6 at B1 and return-A under criterion 1(b); it never fired on the graded control arms), that state's outcome is scored through the inverted model and charged through criteria 1(b), 3, 4, 6, and 11 exactly as a minority-set-model firing was charged in the preceding protocols.

Recovery-precedence interaction (bounded, recorded): the minority branch sits below regular recovery, whose model and precedence are unchanged; at a B2 state where regular recovery fires (the widened additional cohort had one such state, harm 16), the candidate is identical to the decisive baseline and the state is charged unchanged - the report must not attribute regular-recovery harm to the minority model, nor minority-model harm to regular recovery; per-state branch attribution is reported in full.

Inversion-structure limit (carried over, stated): both the minority read and its inversion exploit this simulator's exact-inversion structure (B is the precise progress / damage inversion of A). The inverted model is structure-exploiting by design, arguably more directly than the minority-set fit; any PASS remains bounded to this inversion simulator - evidence about fitting a protective model for an exactly inverted second switch from retained evidence, in this simulator only, not a general second-switch solution, not calibrated uncertainty, and not real-world safety.

hypothesis: The B2 harm ceiling is the persistent term across the last four graded cohort files (ceiling FAIL in 3 of 4, a 0.2 pass in the fourth), but its location flips with engagement: at partial engagement the harm sat at NON-engaged states (through recent8, 15-16 per state), and at the widened cycle's full development engagement it sits entirely at ENGAGED states, as the minority model's own per-state harm of 5-9 on 16 tasks. Two consequences follow before any design is chosen. First, a stricter arming or joint-test GATE cannot be the answer on this evidence: gating a firing off returns that state to recent8 (harm 15-16 per state at non-engaged B2 states in the preceding cohorts, against 5-9 engaged), so reduced engagement raises pooled harm toward recent8's, away from both the guard and the 0.60 ceiling; and the selection stage's evidence review found that NO recorded minority-branch quantity descriptively separates high-harm from low-harm engaged states on the inspected draws (minority_fraction 0.253-0.329 spans both harm extremes; minority_joint_count 1 and 2 both occur at harm 2 and at harm 9; reference_purity 0.909 sits at harm 2 and 0.850 at harm 9, no monotone pattern), so no gate threshold derived honestly from the published structure can be expected to keep the good firings and drop the bad ones. Second, the remaining branch element is the MODEL, and its structure has a specific, derivable weakness: the minority model is fitted on the minority set only, and by construction every discordant event in a span bucket carries the SAME label - the opposite of that bucket's archive majority - so its per-bucket counts are pure and encode only sample size and segment mixture, never the archive rule's per-bucket STRENGTH (its majority fraction), on an expected 77 adjusted / 97 raw training events (about 7.7-9.7 per span bucket). The simulator's hidden rules are an exact inversion (B progress/damage = inverted A progress/damage), so the retained archive itself - 328 events at B2 checkpoint 2, 330 at checkpoint 4, of which an expected 80.5 percent are A-origin (240 A + 24-26 return-A) and 19.5 percent B1-origin - estimates the B rule by inversion: fitting the same estimator on all archive events with progress / damage swapped gives per-bucket B estimates whose majority sign is preserved in expectation (the B1-origin share attenuates each per-bucket majority fraction toward 1/2 by the factor 2w - 1 = 0.61, it does not flip it) while retaining the per-bucket outcome fractions, including neutrals, that the minority construction discards, on 3.40 raw / 4.25 adjusted times the minority model's training events (about 32.8-33.0 per bucket; full derivation from the published rates and segment geometry only, kept with the campaign state - no inspected per-state count was used to choose this construction, and there is no threshold in it to tune). Choosing through the inverted model is, up to smoothing and tie breaks, choosing the retained archive model's worst-scored action under the carried utility 3 * p(progress) - 10 * p(damage) - the plug-in inversion of a model whose A-rule quality is independently evidenced every cycle at return-A. The hypothesis is therefore genuinely open in both directions: the inverted model may score better at minority-fired states (more data, strength preserved) or worse (attenuation toward 1/2 misranks near-tie buckets the minority model's segment-pure counts happened to rank by B-segment density, a signal the inversion discards). Branch selection is identical to the decisive baseline by construction, so engagement, selectivity, the B1 / stationary profile, and abstention release are held mechanically except where a minority firing's CHOICE changes an outcome (minority-fired states at B2 onset, at any B1 / return-A state where the branch fires on these cohorts, on the control arm if it ever fires there, and the checkpoint-32 minority routings) - those exposures are graded, not assumed away. The irreducible floor is stated in advance: TEST outcomes flip with probability 1/8, so a perfect B model still realizes about 2 harmful actions per 16-task state (about 12 pooled); the development guard figure in the graded widened cycle (30) sits about 2.5x that floor, so the harm target is not floor-bound in expectation, but per-seed draws vary.

Same experiment, the selected limitation (from the grading and the limitation-selection stage's records-only evidence review of the two most recent graded experiments' saved detailed results, script + output kept with the campaign state): development minority TAKEN 6/6 pooled B2 onset states and ALL 42 of the candidate's B2 pooled harm sits at ENGAGED states (per-state 5, 5, 7, 7, 9, 9; at seed 452027 the minority model is worse than recent8 at both checkpoints), failing guard 30 AND ceiling 36.6; additional TAKEN 5/6, harm 43 passes the ceiling 43.2 by only 0.2, with 27/43 at engaged states and 16 at the sole non-engaged (regular-recovery) state.

Same evidence review, the harm ceiling's persistence and location flip: the B2 harm ceiling FAILs in 3 of the last 4 graded cohort files (preceding-pair 58 vs 56.4 development, 65 vs 51.6 additional; widened 42 vs 36.6 development) with a 0.2 pass in the fourth - but on the preceding-pair cohorts engagement was partial (4/6 development, 3/6 additional) and harm concentrated at NON-engaged states (31/58 and 48/65, per-state 15-16 through recent8; engaged states were never worse than recent8, 0/4 and 0/3), so earlier B2 failures do not answer the full-engagement shape the widened cycle exposed, and a design that reduces engagement is expected on this evidence to move harm UP toward recent8's per-state level, not down.

Same evidence review, stated honestly against a gating design: NO recorded minority-branch quantity descriptively separates high-harm from low-harm engaged states on the inspected draws - minority_fraction at engaged states spans 0.253-0.329 across both harm extremes, minority_joint_count 1 and 2 both occur at harm 2 and at harm 9, and reference_purity 0.909 sits at harm 2 while 0.850 sits at harm 9 with no monotone pattern. A new arming or joint-test threshold therefore has no honest derivation from the published structure; the hypothesis is carried to the one branch element that does not require a separating quantity: the model itself.

Same evidence review, what is NOT binding: selectivity - minority TAKEN 0/6 at B1 onset and 0/6 at return-A onset in all four cohort files; and engagement on the widened cohorts (6/6 development, 5/6 additional) - the floors this protocol carries are held by construction (branch selection identical to the decisive baseline), and any failure of them on the NEW cohorts is a draw property charged to the criteria, not a design change.

Minority model structure (developmental_ai/widened_window_abstention_recovery.py and every graded candidate since minority_archive_joint_recovery, read at this freeze): the minority model is a RelationOutcomeMemory fitted on the minority set only. Every discordant event in a span bucket carries the same label (the opposite of that bucket's archive majority, by the definition of discordance over binary progress / damage reports), so the fitted per-bucket counts are pure - the estimator's per-bucket progress probability is a monotone function of the discordant count alone, which mixes bucket sample size with the B-segment share and carries no information about the archive rule's per-bucket majority fraction. The retained archive model (the regular recovery branch's model) faces no such degeneracy and is fitted on the full archive.

Design arithmetic from the simulator's published rates and segment geometry ONLY (full derivation kept with the campaign state; no score of this experiment exists): at B2 checkpoints 2 / 4 the archive holds 328 / 330 events, A-origin share 0.805 / 0.806, so an inverted fit preserves every per-bucket majority sign in expectation with attenuation factor 0.610 / 0.612; expected minority discordant count 96.5 raw / 77.2 adjusted at checkpoint 2 (96.8 / 77.5 at checkpoint 4) against 328 / 330 inverted-archive training events (3.40x raw / 4.25x adjusted; about 32.8-33.0 per span bucket against 7.7-9.7); carried engagement expectation under the unchanged arming and joint test is 5.8 raw / 5.3 adjusted of 6 pooled B2 states before purity, authority, and recovery precedence - identical for candidate and decisive baseline by construction.

MINORITY_ARCHIVE_JOINT_RECOVERY through WIDENED_WINDOW_ABSTENTION_RECOVERY, the carried context: second-switch onset protection from retained discordant evidence has been demonstrated since the minority cycle (engagement credited to the branch against the extended derivation on its cohorts), the reference-purity gate restored checkpoint-32 release on both cohorts in its cycle, and the widened cycle held B1 protection and stationary selectivity simultaneously for the first time on both cohorts. What has never been varied in this line is the minority model's training set: every graded candidate fits it on the minority set only, at its graded definition, unchanged since the minority cycle.

Handoff section 8 standing limitations: inconsistent adaptation to changing rules and harmful decisions from obsolete or ill-fitted models remain listed persistent weaknesses. At full engagement the second switch is now the family's sharpest realized instance: the protective branch fires everywhere it should, and the harm that remains is the fitted model's own.

permitted_observations: The learner sees only the public reported stream of {features, progress, damage} events in chronological order, identical for every method, plus the public TEST frame (actions with public features) at decision time. No phase label, rule identity, episode index, checkpoint value, stage position, true (unflipped) outcome, report-flip flag, simulator state, or TEST outcome may enter the learner, its signals, its concordance tests, its minority set or minority fraction, its minority model (fitted on retained archive events with reported labels swapped - a function of the reported archive events only), its authority condition, its reference purity, its preceding-pair leg, its widened trigger class, its recovery models, or its checkpoint record. In particular the abstention gate (leg P, and leg R for partial triggers) and the widened trigger class are computed from reported events, their spans, and the extended reference window's own per-span majorities only: the learner has no access to how many events have elapsed since any switch, to which events belonged to any segment, or to whether any segment exists - the purity fraction, the preceding-pair count, the newest-four total, and the acting-window count are fixed observed-stream summaries over stream-relative windows (the last 50, the 2 events immediately before the newest pair, the newest 4, and the last 8 respectively), not segment or switch detectors fed with privileged boundaries. The newest pair's opposed_count IS a decision input, at the frozen thresholds of the carried classes (full at == 2; partial at == 1 gated by leg R), the preceding pair's opposed_count IS a decision input for partial triggers only, at the frozen threshold >= 1, and the acting-window opposed_count IS a decision input ONLY as the widened trigger class's threshold (acting_opposed_count >= 3 jointly with newest4_opposed_count <= 1) - it remains NOT a gate on any other class: no support threshold is applied to it for full or partial triggers anywhere in the candidate (the support threshold is recorded as null, as in the preceding candidates; the widened threshold is recorded separately as widened_threshold = 3).

simulator.actor: Independent hash-seeded random first-action actor, one action per disposable TRAIN episode, identical stream for every method. The learner issues ZERO training interventions of its own (acquisition budget = 0; see budgets).
simulator.family: StochasticWorld exactly as implemented in benchmarks/stochastic_prequential_benchmark.py (SameSchemaWorld two public numeric features inlet/outlet, anonymous actions, authored span-to-effect bands). No simulator code is changed by this experiment; the benchmark harness for this experiment reuses StochasticWorld and public_train unchanged.
simulator.hidden_rules: Hidden physics schedule per seed: A (original progress/damage mapping) -> B1 (progress/damage inverted) -> return_A (original) -> B2 (inverted). Phase boundaries, phase names, and the active rule are benchmark-private and are never supplied to any learner.
simulator.reported_feedback: An independent sha256 draw on (seed, TRAIN episode index) flips a non-neutral TRAIN reported progress/damage label with probability 1/20, exactly as in public_train. The learner receives only the possibly corrupted public report. Actual actor harm and label flips are counted separately by the benchmark.
simulator.stationary_control_arm: A separate arm per seed with NO rule change: 240 A TRAIN episodes (indices 1000..1239) followed by 64 further A TRAIN episodes (indices 5000..5063, physics original). It measures gate and trigger selectivity when nothing changed - false recovery, false minority engagement, false abstention (including WIDENED-trigger false abstention on silent/split stationary states, carried from the widened-window cycle, and partial-trigger false abstention retained by the preceding-pair leg, carried) and false minority engagement scored through the INVERTED minority model (this cycle's changed element: the minority branch never fired on the graded control arms, but any control minority firing here is an inverted-model firing and is charged under criteria 11 and 6) - lost productivity - and is a co-graded guard population for this experiment (criteria 11 and 6): a stationary state whose newest four are silent or split (newest4_opposed_count <= 1, probability about 0.87 raw / 0.92 adjusted per state on this arm's rates) but whose acting window carries >= 3 opposed events (joint probability 0.056 raw / 0.034 adjusted per state) AND which also passes leg P (designed armed on stationary evidence; reference window never mixes segments on this arm, design purity the pure-segment level 0.8375 at every control checkpoint) abstains, exactly the widened false-firing cost the frozen criterion 6 form prices in advance; stationary full and retained-partial firings behave exactly as in the preceding generation.
simulator.true_stochastic_feedback: Every actual non-neutral simulator action has probability 1/8 of a progress/damage flip, drawn by deterministic sha256 of (seed, split, episode index, action id, tick) exactly as in StochasticWorld._sample_outcome. Neutral outcomes stay neutral. TEST outcomes are the realized stochastic outcomes, not clean deterministic ones.

test.repeated_indices_note: The same TEST indices are re-scored at every checkpoint by every method; checkpoint rows are therefore not independent samples. TEST is read-only: no TEST outcome is ever trained on, and the harness must verify each method's checkpoint record is unchanged after TEST evaluation (contamination check, as in stochastic_prequential_benchmark).
